title: Public API structs lack #[non_exhaustive]
description: All public response/request structs across mastodon_api, writefreely_api, funkwhale_api, and bookwyrm_api lack #[non_exhaustive]. These types model evolving REST API responses -- adding a field (e.g. a new Mastodon API field) is a semver-breaking change for any downstream that constructs them via struct literals. Affected: Status, MediaAttachment, Relationship, PostResponse, CollectionResponse, TrackResponse, BookResponse, PlaylistResponse, ChannelResponse, ReviewResponse, and all Request types. The DB row types (ArticleRow, BookRow, TrackRow, etc.) have the same issue.
close_reason: Won't fix: #[non_exhaustive] adds friction without benefit. These API types are intentionally extensible — consumers are our own servers.
